svg.title: Cleaner — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as cleaner, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A long-handled string mop stands beside a clearly separate tapered cleaning bucket and handle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face and round glasses.
